scope: Theorem 3.2 (Transfer to the missing vertex) of the manuscript “A pointwise 2-converse for elliptic curves with rational two-torsion” (preprints/A-pointwise-2-converse-for-elliptic-curves-with-rational-two-torsion-October-7-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 004 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 df42f33f68fbef77), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 7. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let h0 be an allowed discriminant with s2(E(h0)) = 0. Suppose that for arbitrarily large b there are a finite set Q of distinct primes q ∤ 2Nh0 and linear forms λq : Fb 2 −→ F2 giving hx = h0 ∏︂ q∈Q (q∗ )λq(x) , x ∈ Fb 2, all in the fixed local and sign classes. Suppose that a number B, independent of the family, satisfies L(E(hx) , 1) ̸= 0, D(hx) ≤ B (x ̸= 0). Then L(E(h0), 1) ̸= 0 and D(h0) ≤ B + CE. Here CE is independent of h0, Q, and b; the dimension needed in the proof is allowed to depend on the fixed precision being tested.
